sections.text: An early frost has sealed the orchard gates. Down the hill, smoke curls from the caretaker’s cottage.

consequence.text: You slip on the frozen iron and land hard.

sections.text: The caretaker wraps your hands in warm cloth and lends you a key.

options.description: Catch your breath and finish the job

consequence.text: A moment of rest restores your strength.

sections.text: You can still turn back. The safer route is within reach.

options.description: Go back and take the safer route

consequence.text: You are hit again before you can get to safety.

sections.text: You open the greenhouse just in time to bring the seedlings inside.
